title: Repository, capability, backend, and test-gate inventory

tier_definitions.production: Complete required operations and live conformance with current receipts.
tier_definitions.conditional: Complete declared subset when a named capability/extra/config is available.
tier_definitions.configuration-only: Validated configuration and health discovery only; no live data-plane claim.
tier_definitions.experimental: Explicitly opt-in and excluded from production routing.
tier_definitions.unsupported: Typed rejection expected before side effects, or construction/path is known broken.
tier_definitions.unknown-pending-proof: Advertised or present in tree but without admitted current-tree correctness evidence.

inventory_observation.note: Recorded at KITA-001 implementation time in the supervisor worktree. A changed revision invalidates historical findings and requires a fresh inventory; it is not automatically a failure.
inventory_observation.dirty_overlay_policy: Dirty overlays invalidate content-bound findings until re-inventoried. This inventory records clean nested trees at observation time.

confirmed_defects.title: VFS no-op rename/move with journal method mismatch

locations.observation: Returns success=True as an explicit placeholder without mutating namespace state; calls filesystem_journal.log_operation.
FilesystemJournal exposes record_operation and related transaction methods but does not define log_operation, so the VFS rename/move journal call site is mismatched.

confirmed_defects.summary: Primary VFS rename_item/move_item report success without mutating state and invoke a journal method that does not exist on FilesystemJournal.

confirmed_defects.title: Overlapping virtual-bucket management planes
confirmed_defects.summary: Multiple bucket management planes maintain overlapping state. Creation crosses directory/index/registry writes without full rollback; Iroh tiering can perform external placement before DuckDB transaction completion without a complete compensation protocol.

confirmed_defects.title: WAL/journal transaction protocol defects

locations.observation: Production path returns a mock_handler and uses random.random() thresholds for simulated success/failure.
Journal API coexists with other WAL variants without shared protocol.

confirmed_defects.summary: Journal/WAL variants do not share a valid transaction protocol: begin/commit IDs and markers can be lost, mutation may precede durable intent, file/parent-directory durability is incomplete, a production path contains a random/mock handler, and checkpoint/archive behavior can skip or delete unrecovered work.

confirmed_defects.title: ARC byte accounting and concurrency defects
confirmed_defects.summary: ARC update and ghost-hit paths can leave live byte accounting stale and violate capacity; mutable lists are not synchronized even though wrappers may dispatch them to threads.

confirmed_defects.title: Shadowed ensure_replication methods

locations.observation: Two methods with the same name in one class body; the later definition shadows the earlier copying implementation. Pending replication can be counted as successful redundancy; cross-field/capability validation is incomplete.

confirmed_defects.summary: A later ensure_replication definition shadows the implementation that performs copying, while pending replication can be counted as successful redundancy.

confirmed_defects.title: Backend registry/schema/adapter factory fracture

locations.observation: 22 registered type plugins (21 legacy + iroh). Planning notes estimated 23.
Calls registry plugin create_filesystem; LegacyBackendPlugin does not implement it, so most named backends cannot use this path.
Smaller adapter registry (ipfs, filesystem, sshfs, s3, minio, digitalocean + iroh special-case).
15 dashboard schema keys including aliases (ipfs-cluster) and non-registry types (lotus, arrow, ipfs-cluster-follow).

confirmed_defects.summary: BackendManager.get_backend_adapter requires create_filesystem absent from the legacy plugin protocol. Registry names, dashboard schemas, and the smaller adapter registry diverge.

confirmed_defects.title: MCP++ server construction failure (EventDAGStore)

locations.observation: Constructor assigns self._dag = EventDAGStore() without importing EventDAGStore in the module, causing NameError on construction.

confirmed_defects.summary: ipfs_kit_py/mcp_server/server.py constructs EventDAGStore without importing it. Focused Profile C/D/MCP++ runs observed construction failures.

confirmed_defects.title: MCP++ policy routed away from datasets Profile D

locations.observation: Active server routes policy evaluation through a permissive competing evaluator path; canonical datasets Profile D bridge and advertised profile expectations are not enforced.

confirmed_defects.summary: Active MCP++ server routes policy to a permissive competing evaluator instead of the canonical datasets Profile D bridge; UCAN/policy evaluation remains advisory with fail-open risk.

confirmed_defects.title: GraphRAG persistence, safety, and schema drift

locations.observation: Loads caller-selected pickle cache files, brute-force scans embeddings, eagerly imports optional ML stacks, may load models during construction.

locations.role: MCP GraphRAG wrapper with potentially incompatible schema

confirmed_defects.summary: Unsafe pickle deserialization; non-durable in-memory NetworkX/RDF views vs SQLite; update history records replacement as prior version; incompatible multi-implementation schemas; no MCP++ GraphRAG tool category.

confirmed_defects.title: Lazy-import, dependency projection, and version drift

locations.observation: Runtime __version__ is 0.2.0 while packaging metadata is 0.3.0.
version = 0.3.0 (must remain a projection of pyproject).
MCP server module eagerly imports anyio, mcplusplus, HierarchicalToolManager.

confirmed_defects.summary: Root/CLI/MCP/installed-package exports, versions, and dependency projections disagree; MCP import eagerly loads heavy optional modules; root package import surface remains broad.
confirmed_defects.planning_reference: IPFS_KIT_RUNTIME_READINESS_PLAN.md § Confirmed baseline blockers; KITA-004 observation anchors

confirmed_defects.title: Default pytest excludes integration WAL/ARC/replica/backend coverage

locations.observation: Hundreds of integration tests including storage_wal, WAL telemetry, filesystem journal, backends, replication — excluded from default collection.

confirmed_defects.summary: Default pytest configuration excludes the integration tree containing most WAL, ARC, replication, and backend coverage. Remaining tests may skip, print, accept either success or failure, permit zero recovered operations, omit assertions, or mock the transaction/recovery methods the release gate must exercise.

capabilities.notes: Construction fails (EventDAGStore unbound); policy routes to a permissive competing evaluator; UCAN/policy advisory and fail-open risks on tools/call.

backends.planning_estimate_note: Objective heap evidence subset cited 23 backend types. Live BackendTypeRegistry with entry points disabled or enabled registers exactly 22 types (21 LEGACY_TYPES + iroh). Inventory uses live count; does not invent a 23rd type.

backends.production_claim_policy: Zero backends are marked production in this inventory. No live conformance receipts are admitted at freeze time.

python_package.notes: JIT/import surface is broad; optional binary install gated by env var.

mcp.notes: Multiple MCP tool registration planes; not yet reduced to one operation registry.

default_pytest_ini.effect: Default collection excludes integration and archived_stale_tests. WAL, ARC, replication, and backend integration coverage is not in the default gate.

pyproject_pytest.notes: Does not restate norecursedirs; pytest.ini remains the practical default for addopts/norecursedirs.

config_pytest_ini.notes: Alternate config under config/; not the package-root default.

runtime_readiness_lane.notes: New KITA foundations tests; not yet a release gate for storage correctness.

optional_dependencies.notes: Optional extras advertise install sets only. Extra presence does not prove backend or capability support. Dependency projection may drift from declared pins (see defect:lazy-import-dependency-version-drift).

daemons_and_providers.notes: Ordinary package imports must not download binaries or start daemons. IPFS_KIT_AUTO_INSTALL_BINARIES=1 opts into package-managed Kubo setup. Daemon/provider availability is configuration-only until health probes and conformance receipts exist.
